Targeted practice with fresh examples

Unit 1 · Week 16 · Lesson 3 · Suggested 55-minute plan; adjust to local timing.

Prepare: Open the exam-preparation chapter and its learning resources. Use paper or a local editor as appropriate, with fictional data and disposable practice copies. The suggested 55-minute lesson is flexible.

Suggested answers are teacher guidance, not extra assessment tasks. These notes are public.

1. Targeted practice with fresh examples

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Learning intention

Explain the goal and the expected independent outcome. Test a repaired idea beyond the original question. This is ungraded textbook learning. Suggested times can be adjusted to the class. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

2. Retrieval and explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual retrieval, then partner comparison

Keep the underlying concept and change data or context. Examples include different negative values, a changed threshold or a new destination subnet. Allow silent thinking before discussion. Ask a learner to justify an answer before revealing the explanation. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

3. Changed-data choices

Suggested time: 6 minutes

Instructional strategy: Worked table and teacher explanation

Expected first maximum index 1/value -2; boundary checks -1,0,10,11; previous file records remain; remote subnet needs routing. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

4. A first-maximum transfer

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Predict, model and explain

Best index changes from 0 to 1 and stays 1 at equality. Starting maximum value at zero would fail for this all-negative list. Pause for predictions before discussing the expected result. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

5. The new boundary

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Guided paired practice

Useful tests are -1,0,1,9,10,11 and invalid text. Distinguish conversion failure from range rejection. Swap explaining and checking roles so both learners articulate the reasoning. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

6. Independent practice

Suggested time: 12 minutes

Instructional strategy: Independent application with optional support

A partner can change values after the learner’s first prediction. Keep a concrete error/correction record for any remaining gap. Offer the relevant worked example if needed, then use a changed case to check independent understanding. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

7. A choice to explain

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Whole-class response and justification

B. Test families should challenge different assumptions, not repeat the same ordinary case. Give thinking time and collect reasons, without recording scores. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

8. Exit explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual reflection and fresh explanation

The explanation should connect the new data to the original faulty assumption or boundary. Use the response to select the next explanation or practice activity. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.
